scope: Read-only current-code and actual-evidence review of scientific/numerical explainability, practical COMSOL scope and independent verification. Only this evidence record written.

score.meaning: Engineering assessment of evidence, interpretation and current supported alpha scope; not probability of correct physics, native accuracy percentage or apparatus certification

criteria.name: Equation/input authority and scientific semantics
criteria.basis: SI, independent mass/radii, same-stage charge and force, explicit model revisions; typed semantic boundaries and result role explanation are incomplete

criteria.name: Independent mathematical/numerical verification
criteria.basis: Current source-bound1240/156 suites include independent event, OU covariance/conditional and coupled-charge convergence; three selected numeric functions freshly passed. This is not every-model/path/mesh resolution qualification

criteria.name: Reproducibility and result-only scientific explanation
criteria.basis: Stable particle/RNG identity, same accepted path, durable context and immutable metadata; missing effective scalar/role projection and limited all-payload content binding remain

criteria.name: Reference comparison and uncertainty interpretation
criteria.basis: A/P40 candidate replicas and visited-state diagnostics support scoped practical transport, with local differences retained; historical executor binding differs from current in7/50sourcefiles and native complete precision remains unqualified

criteria.name: Claim limits and diagnostic honesty
criteria.basis: Practical agreement, numerical qualification, physical validation, failed coverage and saved-path limitations are clearly separated; one documented stage-order statement contradicts actual arithmetic order

findings.classification: Confirmed loss of scientific explanation, no demonstrated wrong trajectory or unsafe resume
findings.issue: resolved_models returns identity plus hand-selected Talbot/lift/electric scalars. Other effective coefficients and role-to-field mapping are not preserved in normal result model explanations. Different Epstein delta values can have identical explanation projections although original case hashes differ.
findings.impact: A result-only user cannot fully explain or distinguish the effective RHS configuration without recovering bound input artifacts.
findings.required_improvement: One effective scalar/role projection from resolved model owner consumed by check/run/result; keep original case identity and avoid full field duplication.

findings.classification: Confirmed guarantee-scope gap, no spontaneous corruption demonstrated
findings.issue: source_identity binds manifest/case/context, while final.h5 is read with structural/finite validation without a whole-final digest in that identity. Older segment completeness/structure and latest checkpoint binding do not establish every consumed numeric payload byte unchanged.
findings.impact: A finite valid-shaped payload edit need not change the advertised source identity; artifact provenance must not be presented as full numerical content-integrity proof.
findings.required_improvement: Define completed payload binding and verified read scope at output owner; translate lazy errors at public read/iterator boundaries; retain structural checks and measure added I/O.

findings.classification: Confirmed documentation mismatch, no reason to reorder arithmetic
findings.issue: Documented order puts ion drag after gravity, but compiled stage evaluates/adds ion before DEP/lift/electric/gravity.
findings.impact: Readers cannot reproduce or assess actual floating-point force accumulation order from the owner document.
findings.required_improvement: Correct the owner explanation to current charge/drag/thermophoresis/ion/DEP/lift/electric/gravity ordering; preserve current arithmetic unless separately scientifically versioned.

cross_domain_confirmed_input_risks.scope: Exact field-node ID is converted to float before join validation, so2^53+1 can join2^53. Existing bounded public probe demonstrates wrong identity acceptance, not wrong physical field values in that witness.
Static builder does not check time_s; a valid canonical time-temperature can receive ready and fail after small solve. No incorrect completed field artifact was demonstrated.

qualification_and_capability_limits.scope: Actual selected-window macro refinement is distinct from accepted particle root/path refinement. Fixed-root prerequisite at806/848/870 is deliberately conservative and returns NOT_TESTED for unsupported or nonzero global work; no false qualified PASS found.
Finite-depth Hermite/OU numerical path event guarantees do not prove continuous OU exact first passage, zero miss, general state-dependent SDE strong order, or all-cohort convergence.

Current producer is static gas-only RZ/P1 with prescribed potentials; historical fullmaterial floatingV/Q field4percent result is not evidence of current capability or precision. This is an explicit scope boundary, not a defect in the reduced problem.
Dense paired-ID saved comparison is descriptive and not a general weighted/unpaired ensemble or staggered-release accuracy certifier.

strengths: One solver engine; external COMSOL adapters and V&V do not own hidden numerical production branches
Same-stage x/v/Z, correct mass authority, explicit cap/noise/force revisions and no silent applicability fallback
Independent Gaussian quadrature, manufactured coupled-state solution and analytic hit tests confirm scientific properties beyond old-output identity
Stable particle identity, conditional OU split and accepted-only state/event semantics support meaningful reproducibility
Result context supports result-only geometry/source/boundary interpretation and avoids inferring physical adhesion/flux from numerical stuck/model weights
Stochastic comparison judges population/outcome distributions without requiring identical random realizations

AP_comparison.practical_judgment: For the original287-particle10nmA/Pcases, large-scale transport/capture/representative times/population curves/destination composition are appropriately matched for qualitative practical transport use. No random-path equality is required.

local_reservations.conditioning: Each own survivor population; not a paired same-ID velocity error

AP_comparison.uncertainty: Candidate40 seed21-60 separately per case versus one saved native realization. A/P share native/random structure and are not pooled as80independent native experiments. Rank non-rejection/prediction range is not formal tolerance equivalence or a CI on the ensemble mean.

historical_replay.scope: Prior resolved_semantics replay/source-bound evidence; not current_only or thisHEAD newly executed COMSOL/particle qualification. Differences are not automatically wrong-physics changes.
